changelog: **The pipeline board pages its columns (#1438):** `GET /api/mentorship?view=board` answers each column's true count (`counts`) and only its first 20 cards; `stage=<key>&page=<n>` loads one more page of one column (the rule is in `src/lib/boardPage.ts`). `/admin/board` takes its column headers, WIP chips and phone filter from those counts, adds a "Show more" button under each column, and searches on the server, so it no longer downloads every relation in the programme (243 KB at 308 relations). `?pageSize=` alone now pages the plain list instead of being silently ignored.

en: The admin board opens faster in large programmes: each column loads its first cards, and "Show more" brings the rest.
tr: Yönetici panosu büyük programlarda daha hızlı açılıyor: her sütun önce ilk kartlarını yüklüyor, "Daha fazla göster" geri kalanını getiriyor.
de: Das Admin-Board öffnet sich in großen Programmen schneller: Jede Spalte lädt zuerst ihre ersten Karten, „Mehr anzeigen“ holt den Rest.
